But shortly after his term began, Castillo faced impeachment proceedings. Less than a year and a half into his tenure, he attempted to dissolve Congress. "In the past, we used to elect presidents for five years. Now, what's more likely is that they will not last five years," said Vilca. But Peru's unicameral Congress will come to an end this year.
